_comment: FILE: approuter/xs-app.json — routes EVERY external call. Diagram: User/UI5/Postman -> Approuter -> (login?) -> srv. authenticationMethod: route = each route decides; /bookstore needs login, /health is public for CF health checks.

routes._comment: HEALTH: CF calls this to decide if srv is alive. No login, else restarts loop forever.
API: the protected OData service. Browsers without session get 302 to XSUAA login (XSUAA Service box). Postman with Bearer JWT passes through; srv xssec returns 401/403 as in diagram.
UI5 APP: demo.shop Component served as static files. Login required so anon cannot fingerprint the UI version. Mirrors app/shop/ (local dev copy).
STATIC: flat files in approuter/resources/ (index.html, styles.css, app.js). Must stay in sync with app/ (local dev copy). Login required so anon cannot fingerprint the UI version.
